verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Lindy publishes an llms.txt at docs.lindy.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200). It indexes the docs as markdown pages (e.g. index.md), which gives an agent a direct, agent-oriented entry point into the documentation. Missing for 10: first-party docs describing the llms.txt/markdown docs offering, evidence of an llms-full.txt or similar full-content export, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.lindy.ai/llms.txt # Lindy Documentation
